# BuoyMarker Class

A [Marker](https://desk.example.com/en/latest/sdk/api-reference/topic101.html) that is drawn as a buoy.

## Syntax

```csharp
public class BuoyMarker : Marker
```

- › [Example.Harbor.Marker](https://desk.example.com/en/latest/sdk/api-reference/topic101.html)

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Colour](https://desk.example.com/en/latest/sdk/api-reference/topic103.html) | Gets or sets the colour of the buoy. |
| [Lit](https://desk.example.com/en/latest/sdk/api-reference/topic104.html) | Gets whether the buoy carries a light. |
